decision.observation: The goose stands at the gate's front-center on the dirt path. The bowl sits slightly behind the gate's lower rails at ~(0.394, 0.647), out of reach. The right post carries a grey lock assembly: upper bracket on the top rail ~(0.699, 0.452) and a lower pipe bend ~(0.727, 0.667), plus a loose grey bolt at the post's base ~(0.703, 0.702).
decision.hypothesis: The lower pipe bend is at goose-head height and is the graspable part of the latch; standing under it and pressing Z (grab) may operate the lock and let the gate swing open.
decision.memory: Latch hardware coordinates in this stable zoom: upper (0.699,0.452), lower bend (0.727,0.667).
